entries.title: Semicircular Timber Pocket Gate
entries.description: One newly authored whole static pasture gate module: three complete curved timber rails form a semicircular pocket on five ground posts, and a separate central ground pivot post carries one diagonal-braced open rectangular gate leaf angled into that pocket on two short fixed metal pins. This is not the old straight picket gate or three-arm turnstile. Thirteen complete closed editable meshes, three opaque constant PBR roles. The entire rail curves and annular leaf frame are new geometry, not imported or multiplied old fence components. Metres, Z up, true horizontal whole-bounds-centred ground origin. Small fixed hidden overlaps support the display; no hinge animation, guaranteed traversable clearance, livestock exclusion, accessibility, regulatory compliance, structural engineering or manufacture claim.

entries.title: Cross-Ribbon Gift Box with Open Loop Bow
entries.description: One complete static wrapped gift parcel: a sealed rectangular body and slightly overhanging lid, two complete narrow ribbon loops passing around the entire parcel in perpendicular planes, and two genuinely open oval ribbon bow loops joined by a central folded block. Seven editable closed solids and two opaque matte solid PBR wrapping roles. The top straps are deliberately layered and the bow loops are actual finite-thickness bands, not painted crosses or filled oval decorations. Not a recoloured plain storage box or separately counted bows. Metres, Z up, front -Y, bounds centred; the outer lower ribbon has a real finite underside at Z0. Small explicitly fixed seat overlaps represent the static lid/ribbon/bow attachments. Sealed external prop only, with no modeled storage interior, opening, thread-by-thread knot topology, cloth physics, unwrapping, manufacture or safety claim.

entries.title: Still-Life Photography Table Set
entries.description: One still-life photography-table scene from the original photography scene program. Five complete original assets: open worktable, open-neck amphora subject seated on its tabletop, tripod camera, octagonal reflector and deep softbox. A scene-only base arranges the whole equipment around the subject at original scale. Complete original local POSITION/NORMAL payloads, materials and internal hierarchies are preserved with exact signed-permutation whole-instance matrices. One scene, zero new independent models. No camera exposure, lens targeting accuracy, lighting performance, adjustable mechanism, table load, human access or safe-workspace claim.

entries.title: Open-Cone Passive Cheer Megaphone
entries.description: One complete static passive cheer megaphone: a thick tapered conical shell with a real broad open mouth, narrow open speaking end and continuous through interior, plus a complete open-loop handgrip bonded beneath the rear cone. Two editable closed solids and three opaque matte PBR roles for exterior, lining and grip. The large mouth is not a flat painted disc and there is no electronic loudspeaker, switch, battery or fictitious powered sound. Not the coiled tube of a bugle or an unrelated fungus with funnel in its name. Newly authored whole cone/lip and finite grip profiles on mature mesh/export tools. Metres, Z up, front -Y, bounds centred, finite grip underside at Z0. Static fixed geometry only; no acoustic gain, electronics, operation, hand fit, manufacture, balance or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Two-Slot Bread Toaster
entries.description: One original empty countertop bread toaster visual prop. A rounded-shoulder continuous body contains two genuinely deep separate top-loading rectangular bread wells with closed floors and full separating bridge. A real shallow vertical end recess supports a fixed stem and faceted grip. An integral base plate has four complete flat grounded feet. Four closed editable material meshes, three opaque untextured PBR materials. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal-bounds-centred grounded soles. Newly authored complete appliance, not the old two-burner stove reduced in size or the front-loading vaulted bakery oven recoloured. No bread, heating wires, cord, electric circuit, pop-up spring or lever travel is modelled; no powered use, food-contact, heat or safety claim.

entries.title: Dry Fountain and Opposed Bench Rest Plaza
entries.description: One static public-park rest-plaza scene, counted as one scene and zero new independent models. One complete unchanged dry two-tier fountain occupies the center of a closed circular scene-only paving slab. Two whole original Tideway slatted benches stand opposite each other, facing inward through exact quarter-turn rotations at unit scale. The complete original GLB mesh sets, oriented triangles and per-face solid PBR assignments are embedded in the self-contained generator; only declared rigid placements and collision-safe name prefixes are added before normal float32 export. Open paving separates both seats from the central basin and continues around the fountain. Four meshes and six materials; the original benchmark bench is one joined GLB mesh and remains one whole mesh per instance. No water, animation, humans, functioning fountain, ergonomic/accessibility evaluation, navigation logic, construction plan, drainage, load or safety certification.

entries.title: Fixed Drum-Cased Grain Winnower
entries.description: One newly authored whole static post-harvest grain-cleaner appearance: a broad horizontal rounded fan housing on a four-legged timber frame, a square open tapering hopper above it, a long downward open discharge trough, and a side offset hand crank with wooden grip. Fourteen closed editable meshes and four constant opaque PBR roles. This is not the old upright coffee hand grinder, tall ribbed silo, twin-wheel bench grinder or stand-alone sieve. The hopper has a real isolated open throat and the trough real upper space; the hidden machine interior, fan blades, screen, gears and continuous internal grain/air connection are deliberately not modeled. Housing is a closed display solid. No animation, airflow, grain separation, milling, harvesting efficiency, real engineering, food-use or historic replica claim. Metres, Z up, actual whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin; small fixed hidden overlaps support the static display.

entries.title: Open Side-Gusset Paper Shopping Bag
entries.description: One original empty upright kraft-paper shopping bag visual prop. A continuous thin closed material shell has a complete rectangular flat bottom, broad planar front and rear sheets and two inward side gusset creases rising to a genuinely open concave-hexagonal mouth. Two separately editable flat U-shaped straps have open centres and four complete lower roots seated on the outside front/rear sheets. Three closed material meshes and two opaque matte untextured PBR materials. Metres, Z up, front -Y and centred grounded bottom. Newly authored folded-sheet form, not the old rounded soft travel holdall resized or the bottomless florist sleeve recoloured. Fixed empty pose only; no contents, print, animation, paper deformation, carrying/load capacity, wet strength, manufacturing or safety claim.

entries.title: Static Broad-Carapace Crab
entries.description: One original stylised crab in a fixed grounded display: a broad short low carapace with continuous lower sternum, four pairs of laterally splayed flattened walking limbs, two stout bent forelimbs ending in complete thick bevelled pincers, and two rising stalked dark eyes. Each pincer has two unequal integral fingers around a genuinely open front notch. Each walking foot ends in a finite flat Z0 toe patch. New whole profiles and coordinates, not a beetle with extra old legs, a recoloured tortoise, an eight-arm octopus or paired serving tongs reused. Seventeen closed editable meshes and four opaque matte constant PBR materials, no textures. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, complete horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One prop, zero scenes; claws, limbs and eyes are not separately counted models. Artistic external exoskeletal silhouette only, not species diagnosis, scientific anatomy, biological internal construction, locomotion, working pincers, rig, animation, collision or stability certification.
